Subject: Follow-up: Procurement & onboarding next steps (Aurora Payments)

Hi Oliver / Grace —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on owners and next steps: 

- Economic buyer: Grace Lin (VP Product) — evaluating product fit and ROI.
- Procurement contact: Oliver Reyes — will handle PO, vendor onboarding, and invoicing cadence.
- Legal: Rajiv Menon — initial T&C redlines & standard vendor agreement.
- Security: Aurora’s Vendor Ops (vendor-ops@aurorapay.com) will request SOC2 and data handling docs.

Decision criteria you called out: latency under 150ms p50 for customer-facing flows, per-embedding cost under $0.002, and a documented data retention + deletion policy.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send our vendor onboarding checklist + SOC2 summary for your vendor ops and legal to review (attached).
2) Oliver: confirm PO process & expected timeline (single PO vs monthly invoice) and any specific billing contact.
3) Rajiv/Legal: let us know if you have standard redlines; we’ll share a plain-language summary before formal redline.
4) Avery (SE) will set up a follow-up call next week to walk performance profile and quantization options.

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If that looks right I’ll loop security and send the checklist to vendor-ops.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — that summary is perfect. A couple of clarifications on timing and invoicing: 

- Pilot PO: we can issue a one-time PO within 10 business days once we have the onboarding docs (SOC2 + checklist + W-9).
- Net terms: we typically do Net 30 on production contracts; for the pilot we can accept Net 45 if needed.
- Invoicing: send invoices to ap@aurorapay.com (cc: vendor-ops).

Rajiv — do you want us to route a redline directly to your legal inbox or should Marissa send a summarized version first?

Thanks Marissa — received. Please route any formal contract redline to legal@aurorapay.com. For speed, a summarized bullet list of material business points we expect (data residency, deletion windows, indemnity caps) would be helpful before formal redline.

- Data residency: US only for customer PII.
- Deletion: ability to delete customer data within 30 days of request.
- Liability cap: standard for vendors of your size; Rajiv to propose language after he reviews the contract.

We’ll review the SOC2 summary and vendor checklist this week. Oliver — once vendor-ops confirms timeline we’ll aim to produce any redline within 7 business days.

Regards,
Rajiv
